correctness.rationale: All quantifiers are six distinct equal-weight spherical 2-design nodes; the rank-projection proof exhausts them by one twist. Cauchy maps their equal-area normals to a six-segment zonotope; the standard 3D zonotope determinant identity reduces volume to 20 minors. Two pure determinants are one each; two mixed sums equal 1+4cos φ by an explicitly verified sign chamber on 0≤φ≤π/3, yielding exactly 32π³(1+2cosφ)/27. The derivative and already proven original-volume formula yield unique extrema and affine quotient. Independent computational routes: direct 20 minors, 64 signed-sum convex hull at five twists, and exact algebraic endpoints. The numerical tests alone are not the continuum proof.

value.rationale: Projection-body volume and the affine projection-volume quotient are canonical, motivated functionals of convex geometry. This result determines their complete sharp profiles on the first nonrigid (six-node) spherical-2-design Minkowski family, quantifies the 3/2 projection-volume variation despite identical normal second moments, and identifies opposite ordering relative to ordinary volume and known random-shadow variance. It is a natural complete invariant classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a single numerical improvement; the exact quotient extrema have potential use as affine-geometric benchmarks.
